b: Wow! We’re down to the final three days. Let’s finish strong!

For today’s prompt, write a remix poem. Take one of your poems (either from this month or an even earlier poem) and remix it. That could mean turning a free verse poem into a traditional form poem (or vice versa). Or maybe focusing in on a line that you really like and turning it into a refrain. One thing I’ve done in the past is to try creating a new poem from the lines of all my previous poems (even if it’s just fitting in a phrase or image from each). Have fun with it!
Remember: These prompts are springboards to creativity. Use them to expand your possibilities, not limit them.

Here’s my attempt at a Remix Poem:

The algorithm of life is found
in the howl beneath a full moon.
If you listen close to the sound,
the algorithm of life is found
as the planet spins round and round
and tilts as if trying to swoon.
The algorithm of life is found
in the howl beneath a full moon.
(Note on my remix: I used some lines from my chaos poem on Day 25 to remix a triolet.)
